building.name: United States Mint
building.completed_conflict: The Market & Octavia context statement describes a building of 1937 at this address; the assessor dates the building on this parcel to 1900.

historic_survey.note: Individually listed in the National Register of Historic Places — one of two buildings in the plan area that are.

historical_record.description: Built as the San Francisco Mint on the crown of Reservoir Hill, where the Spring Valley Water Company's reservoir had been, to a Moderne design by Gilbert Stanley Underwood, Supervising Architect of the U.S. Treasury. It took over the functions of the Old Mint at Fifth and Mission.
